about_history_p1: Instalaciones de Sistemas de Alarma S.A (INSA), founded in April 1983, with extensive experience spanning over 43 years in residential and business security.
about_history_p2: The project that started in the basics of alarms with great enthusiasm has evolved constantly thanks to new technologies into CCTV, IP cameras, sophisticated anti-intrusion means, fire detection, video analysis, etc.
about_history_p3: After-sales service is a distinguishing quality of ours, as we service all brands in the sector, providing continuous consulting to all our clients.
about_philosophy_p1: We offer Security, Peace of Mind, and Control. Our technical team and human personnel provide the personalized treatment that sets us apart from other companies. We understand our clients' needs and advise them on the best options.
about_philosophy_p2: We use equipment from the best brands on the market, with an optimal price-quality ratio.
about_future_p1: Beyond personal service to our clients, we quickly address and resolve any issues from other brands (due to poor after-sales service or dissatisfaction with prior installations), aiming to become your security consultants and make you our Clients and Friends.

about_block1_title: Instalaciones de Sistemas de Alarma S.A.
about_block1_p1: At Instalaciones de Sistemas de Alarma S.A. (INSA), we are dedicated to the protection of people and property. We are certified and trained to detect errors, analyze them, and help prevent them from happening again.
about_block1_p2: For over 43 years, we have traveled a path full of countless challenges, with blind trust in our work, seriousness, and utmost professionalism.
about_block2_p1: Founded in April 1983, with extensive experience spanning over 43 years in residential and business security. The project that started with the basics of alarms with great enthusiasm has constantly evolved toward CCTV, IP cameras, and video analytics.
about_block2_p2: After-sales service is a quality that sets us apart, handling all brands in the sector alongside continuous advisory support.
about_block3_p1: We offer Security, Peace of Mind, and Control. Our technical team provides the personalized service that differentiates us, capturing the real needs of each client and recommending the best option with an optimal quality-price ratio.
about_block3_p2: We care about solving any issues from other brands (due to dissatisfaction or poor after-sales service), becoming your trusted consultants to make you Clients and Friends.
